name: mikoto-apply-patch
description: Mikoto Apply Patch: a Codex-style apply_patch tool for Pi.

scripts.build: napi build --cwd . --manifest-path Cargo.toml --package apply-patch-napi --package-json-path package.json --output-dir native --platform --esm --release
scripts.build:debug: napi build --cwd . --manifest-path Cargo.toml --package apply-patch-napi --package-json-path package.json --output-dir native --platform --esm
